# Psalm 38 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 38:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-psalm of-David. For-a-memorial.
- **LOGOS:** A psalm of David, for the memorial offering.
- **PNEUMA:** A psalm of David, asking God to remember him.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 38:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** YHWH, do-not in-Your-anger rebuke-me, and-in-Your-wrath do-not discipline-me.
- **LOGOS:** O LORD, rebuke me not in Your anger, nor discipline me in Your wrath!
- **PNEUMA:** LORD, don't rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your rage.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 38:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For Your-arrows have-sunk into-me, and-Your-hand has-come-down upon-me.
- **LOGOS:** For Your arrows have sunk into me, and Your hand has come down on me.
- **PNEUMA:** Your arrows have pierced me deeply; Your blows are crushing me.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 38:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For my-loins are-filled with-burning, and-there-is-no soundness in-my-flesh.
- **LOGOS:** For my sides are filled with burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
- **PNEUMA:** A raging fever burns within me, and my health is broken.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 38:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-am-feeble and-crushed utterly; I-groan because-of the-turmoil of-my-heart.
- **LOGOS:** I am feeble and crushed; I groan because of the tumult of my heart.
- **PNEUMA:** I am exhausted and completely crushed. My groans come from an anguished heart.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 38:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** My-heart pounds; my-strength fails-me, and-the-light of-my-eyes — even-it [is] not with-me.
- **LOGOS:** My heart throbs; my strength fails me, and the light of my eyes — it also has gone from me.
- **PNEUMA:** My heart beats wildly, my strength fails, and I am going blind.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
